fitted_reliance.position_preserving_removal_reason: The compatibility interface does not expose verified query and attention key/value masks.

metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: (Mean off-diagonal cosine + 1)/2 among up to 2048 nonpadding item embeddings, sampled with seed 42. Values near 0.5 correspond to mean cosine near zero; higher values indicate greater directional alignment. This is fitted embedding geometry, not evidence about user diversity, preference or recommendation quality. Null if fewer than two items.
metric_definitions.embedding_sample_count: Number of nonpadding embeddings sampled for the cosine statistic.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean fitted positive-minus-negative logit over nonpadding, distinct positive/negative pairs; null without valid pairs.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank 10th percentile of the same fitted margins; null without valid pairs.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid pairs with margin below zero; null without valid pairs.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid pairs with margin below 0.5; logit-scale dependent and null without valid pairs.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Reports valid-position and batch counts and thresholds. Category lists remain empty because category metadata is unavailable.
metric_definitions.fitted_recent_gate: Sigmoid of an exposed scalar recent_gate parameter, otherwise null. A fitted coefficient is not a causal reliance estimate or validation improvement.
metric_definitions.fitted_reliance: Training-only fitted-model probe, separate from host validation: each sampled user's final training event is the target, and only preceding events enter the input. The target still participated in fitting. Users need at least six observed prefix events. The effective prefix is truncated to model.maxlen. Seed 42 selects up to 200 users and 99 unique negatives per user, excluding the target and original complete training history. Fixed candidate order breaks score ties identically across interventions. Delete k=min(3,floor(prefix_length/2)) recent events including the final event, oldest events, or uniformly selected events; all deletions compact survivors through ordinary left padding and thus change positions and adjacency. Five earlier-event permutations preserve the last event, multiset and length and are averaged within user. Rank delta is intervention minus baseline (positive means worse); HR@10 delta is intervention minus baseline; top10_overlap is intersection size divided by 10. Within this dataset, 2000 seed-42 paired user bootstrap replicates yield 95% percentile intervals after averaging shuffle repetitions. Prefix-length and training-frequency tertile groups are descriptive. Intervals condition on the fitted model and fixed candidates; they exclude training-seed variability and do not remove target contamination or validation-selection optimism. Four-category macro results require paired aggregation across all four views and are unavailable here. Position-preserving removal is unavailable without verified encoder masks. Metadata availability counts sampled user-item pairs from training histories; titles/descriptions alone establish neither compatibility nor need. No ratings, review text, category metadata, prices, stores or simulator traits are used. These probes do not estimate held-out performance.
